description: Fetch observations for up to 3 ILOSTAT datasets, filtered by reference area or area group, sex, breakdown codes (classif1, classif2), source, and period. Rows keep their source, observation status, decoded notes, and a basis — reported, modelled_estimate, or projection — and the response echoes every filter applied, including the best-source default. Codes are checked against ILOSTAT's dictionaries before the request is sent: ilostat_list_reference lists valid codes and ilostat_describe_indicator lists the codes a dataset actually uses. A result larger than the inline preview is staged in full as a df_<id> dataframe for SQL through ilostat_dataframe_describe and ilostat_dataframe_query when this deployment enables dataframes. A request with no filters at all is refused when the dataset exceeds the row ceiling, and a filtered request that still exceeds it is refused with guidance to narrow it.

area_group.description: X01 for every country, an ILO region or subregion, or a World Bank income group (X06, X56, X02, …); expands to its member countries, unioned with ref_areas. ilostat_list_reference topic area_groups lists the codes.

classif1.description: Codes of the first breakdown (e.g. AGE_YTHADULT_YGE15); case-insensitive. ilostat_describe_indicator lists the codes a dataset uses.

classif2.description: Codes of the second breakdown, for datasets that have one; case-insensitive. ilostat_describe_indicator lists them.

dataset_ids.description: One to three dataset IDs — an indicator code plus _A, _Q, or _M (UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A), as ilostat_search_indicators returns them. Case-insensitive; a DF_ prefix (the SDMX dataflow form) is stripped, a bare indicator code resolves when it has one frequency, and an element holding + or , joined IDs is split.

latest_only.description: Only the latest period per reference area and dataset (the latest quarter or month on sub-annual datasets); combines with time_from/time_to.

ref_areas.description: Reference areas (up to 300): ISO3 country codes (USA) or X-coded aggregates (X01 World); case-insensitive, ILO_GEO_ forms accepted. Aggregates need a dataset with has_aggregates true. Omit for every area.

sex.description: Sex codes SEX_T, SEX_M, SEX_F, SEX_O; T/M/F/O and total/both/male/female/other are accepted.

source_selection.description: best (default): the preferred source per area and period; all: secondary sources too, each row flagged best_source; secondary: secondary sources only. Defaults to all when sources is set.

sources.description: Source codes (e.g. BA:453); ilostat_list_reference topic sources with ref_area lists an area's sources. Without source_selection, setting sources switches it to all, since a secondary source matches nothing under best.

time.description: One exact period: YYYY (on a quarterly or monthly dataset, every period of that year), YYYYQn, or YYYYMmm; 2024-Q2, 2024 Q2, and 2025-03 are normalized. Not combinable with time_from, time_to, or latest_only.

time_from.description: First year (YYYY); upstream filters by year only.

name: ilostat_query_indicator

applied_filters.description: Every parameter sent upstream, defaults included.

area_group.description: The area group and how many countries it expanded to.

latest_only.description: Whether only the latest period per area was requested.

ref_area_count.description: Areas sent upstream: ref_areas plus the area_group members.

source_selection.description: Source selection applied (all when sources were given without one).

attribution.description: Citation to keep with any use of the data.

cap.description: Inline preview budget, in serialized characters.

dataframe.description: The staged dataframe holding the full result; present only when staged.

evicted.description: Dataframes dropped, oldest first, to keep this tenant within 1,000,000 staged rows and 100 dataframes; present only when staging this one evicted any.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry of the staged dataframe.

name.description: Staged dataframe name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX) for ilostat_dataframe_query SQL.

datasets.description: The requested datasets, in request order.

items.description: One requested dataset and how its values are classed.

edition.description: The edition the cutoff derives from, e.g. Nov. 2025.

has_aggregates.description: Whether the dataset carries World, regional, or income-group rows.

label.description: Dataset label as ILOSTAT publishes it.

last_update.description: Last upstream update, ISO 8601 without zone offset.

projection_after_year.description: Last year counted as an estimate; modelled rows after it are classed projection.

projection_rule.description: How the cutoff was set: the label's edition, the catalog's latest ILO modelled estimates edition, or the year before the current year.

unit.description: Unit of the values, already in the multiplier scale; absent when unresolved.

measure.description: Unit code (PT percent, PS persons, LC local currency, …).

multiplier.description: Power of ten values are expressed in: 0 units, 3 thousands, 6 millions.

type.description: Unit type code (RT rate, NB number, …).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_dataset`: A dataset ID is not in the catalog, or a bare indicator code has several frequencies. `unknown_code`: A ref_areas, sex, classif1, classif2, or sources value is not in the ILOSTAT dictionaries. `unknown_area_group`: area_group is not X01, an ILO region or subregion, or a World Bank income group. `aggregates_unavailable`: An X-coded aggregate was requested from a dataset that has no aggregate rows. `invalid_period`: A sub-annual time on a dataset of another frequency, time combined with a range or latest_only, or time_from after time_to. `request_too_broad`: No filters at all and the unfiltered size exceeds the row ceiling. `result_too_large`: The filtered result passed the row ceiling while streaming. `dataset_retired`: Upstream reports a catalog dataset ID as deprecated or invalid. `upstream_busy`: The server-side pacer shed the call, or the ILOSTAT API answered 429 or a challenge page. `catalog_unavailable`: No catalog snapshot has loaded and the load failed, or the first load has not finished within 30 s. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

legend.description: Labels for every code in rows.

classif1.description: classif1 code → label, for every code in rows.

classif2.description: classif2 code → label, for every code in rows.

notes.description: Note code → label, for every code in rows.

obs_status.description: Observation status code → label, for every code in rows.

ref_area.description: Reference area code → label, for every code in rows.

sex.description: Sex code → label, for every code in rows.

source.description: Source code → label, for every code in rows.

notice.description: Filters that could not narrow a dataset, a unit the structure service could not supply, why nothing matched, where the full result is staged, or why reading stopped early.

row_count.description: Rows the request returned — exact when the result is inline or staged; when reading stopped early (truncated), the rows read.

rows.description: Inline preview rows; the staged dataframe holds every row when the result is larger.

basis.description: reported (national or institutional source), modelled_estimate (ILO modelled, up to the cutoff), or projection (ILO modelled, after it).

best_source.description: Whether this is the preferred source; set only when secondary sources were requested.

classif1.description: First breakdown code, when the dataset has one.

classif2.description: Second breakdown code, when the dataset has one.

sex.description: Sex code; absent when the dataset has no sex breakdown.

value.description: Value in the dataset unit; absent when upstream sent none.

summary.description: Summary over every row read, not just the preview.

modelled_estimate.description: ILO modelled estimates up to the cutoff.

projection.description: ILO modelled values after the cutoff.

reported.description: Values from a national or institutional source.

complete.description: False when reading stopped early, so the counts cover only the rows read.

period_max.description: Latest period; absent on zero rows.

period_min.description: Earliest period; absent on zero rows.

ref_areas.description: Distinct reference areas in the rows read.

truncated.description: True when reading stopped at the inline preview and more rows exist.
